messages:
Elliot: Morning — quick async: landed the kernel patch that changes the op scheduler. Ran a microbatch E2E overnight, saw ~6% p95 improvement on short requests.
Priya: Nice! which PR? canary already rolled? :tada:
Elliot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/812 — canary deployed to shard-3 at 02:10 UTC, ops-bot reported no crashes but KV hit-rate dropped ~4% during the swap.
Jonas: curious about that KV drop. did the patch change prefetch timing? I thought we only touched the scheduler.
Elliot: It nudges when batches are flushed; that can change request interleaving and warmup. I suspect a transient mismatch with our hot-key heuristics.
Maya: FYI ran a 30m perf bench with long sequences (seq=4096). saw throughput dip ~8% on warmup window, p99 stable though. results gist: https://gist.github.com/maya/bench-0316
Priya: can you paste the bench command? want to replicate quickly.
Maya: ```bash
./bench --model gpt-small --seq 4096 --concurrency 12 --duration 1800
```
Jonas: I'll run a focused KV warmup test against shard-3, toggling `max_batch_delay_ms` 20/10/5 and the prefetch window. ping me if you want the runs.
Elliot: blocked on reproducing a minor OOM in canary under synthetic spike — logs show small native mem bump during batch flush.
Jonas: I can look after lunch. if it's the alloc path we touched, should be quick.
Priya: quick ask: can we keep scheduler at 20ms for dedicated until warmup is stable? ops SLOs prefer predictability.
Elliot: ok will revert canary to 20ms delay for now, then we iterate on a fix in next patch. I'll open follow-up ticket.
ops-bot: deploy status: rollback to commit b4c9f2 initiated at 03:05 UTC — success on shard-3 :white_check_mark:
Maya: thanks — I'll rerun the long-seq bench against the rolled-back canary and post diffs.
Elliot: today: investigate OOM trace, add microbench for KV prefetch patterns, follow up with PR to adjust delay heuristics.
Priya: today: validate bench results, coordinate canary cadence with SRE, prep short note for release channel.
Jonas: today: run targeted alloc profiler + warmup sweep, push a small reproducer if I find it.
Maya: today: rerun bench, collect latency heatmap and upload artifacts.
Elliot: leave any blockers here; tagging @Jonas for profiler help. thanks all.
